newsitem.title: USA: Del Global Technologies Q3 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Del Global Technologies Q3 sales rise.

text.p: Del Global Technologies Corp Monday said its sales for the third quarter of 1997 ended May 2, increased 13.5 percent to about $14.3 million from about $12.6 million in the same period last year.
The company said sales for the first nine months of its fiscal 1997 rose about 33.7 percent to about $39.3 million from approximately $29.4 million for last year's comparable period.
The company's backlog as of May 2 was approximately $22.0 million.
"The company's third quarter and nine month revenues are on track with our fiscal 1997 business plan," Del Global's chief executive officer Leonard Trugman said.

Trugman added that "The company continues to explore joint ventures and merger/acquisition opportunities on a global basis. (The company) also continues to invest aggressively in research and development and the expansion of our international sales activities."
Del Global Technologies is primarily engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of cost-effective medical imaging and diagnostic systems.
